note: Three hand-authored personas for the Code of Conduct Notice completeness validator. validateForm(data) checks 6 required fields (3 recipient-details, 3 acknowledgement-signature) and treats the boolean 'agreed' field's value false as empty for completeness purposes - so an explicitly UNCHECKED box fires REQ-AK-001 exactly like a never-touched one, even when the recipient typed their name and date (this is the same state the separate acknowledgementStatus() helper in types.js would label 'declined', but that helper is not part of validateForm's own output). completeness = round((total-fired)/total*100); status is 'Complete' only at exactly 100%. detectAdditionalFlags(state) is a split engine (form-app.js calls it as detectAdditionalFlags(state), a single argument) whose FLAG-NAME-001 check is independent of validateForm entirely - it fires whenever a typed name is 1-2 characters, regardless of whether the other required fields are met. Regenerate expected with: bin/test-personas code-of-conduct-notice --update

personas.name: Fully acknowledged - all six fields complete
personas.description: Every required field filled and the checkbox agreed. Expect completeness 100, status 'Complete', no fired rules, no flags.

personas.name: Declined - typed name and date present but the checkbox is unchecked
personas.description: Non-critical edge case demonstrating the false-counts-as-empty behaviour: recipient details are complete and the recipient typed their full name and today's date, but explicitly left the acknowledgement checkbox unchecked (agreed: false). Expect completeness 83 (5 of 6 required fields count as filled; REQ-AK-001 alone fires), status 'Incomplete', and exactly one flag: FLAG-NOACK-001 (high).

firedRules.description: Recipient must check the acknowledgement checkbox

validationErrors.description: Recipient must check the acknowledgement checkbox

additionalFlags.message: Recipient has not acknowledged the code of conduct

personas.name: Critical - blank recipient details with an implausibly short typed name
personas.description: Critical/highest-severity persona for this completeness form: recipient details are entirely blank, the checkbox is unchecked, the typed date is blank, and the typed name is 'Al' (2 characters - non-blank, so it does NOT fire REQ-AK-002, but IS short enough to fire the independent FLAG-NAME-001 check). Expect completeness 17 (1 of 6 fields counts as filled - the non-blank typed name), status 'Incomplete', five fired rules (REQ-RD-001, REQ-RD-002, REQ-RD-003, REQ-AK-001, REQ-AK-003 - REQ-AK-002 does not fire), and three flags in priority order: FLAG-NOACK-001 (high), FLAG-CONFIG-001 (high, listing all three missing recipient-detail fields), FLAG-NAME-001 (medium).
